title: The Glass Formicarium
summary: An interactive Three.js brass-framed glass formicarium cutaway revealing living ant tunnels, seed vaults, fungal gardens, and the queen’s nursery.
description: An interactive Three.js natural-history diorama and 30-second macro film. A brass-framed glass cabinet on a naturalist's oak table exposes a living cross-section of soil, dew-covered canopy, seed vaults, fungal gardens, and busy leafcutter ants tending the queen's nursery.
